posts.body_html: Don't dismiss the chicken thing too fast. Grouse are great with a little orange sauce, or roasted in bacon. They're not known for being one of the brightest birds in the world. A running joke with deer and elk hunters that there's know need to shoot one, just walk over hit it with a stick to bag one.
